claims: Easter Monday is not a federal holiday in the United States.
Easter Monday is a public holiday in several other countries.
U.S. federal offices, banks, post offices, and schools typically remain open and operate on a normal schedule on Easter Monday.
USPS mail is delivered on Easter Monday.
Legislation has been introduced to make Easter Monday a federal holiday.
Legislation to make Easter Monday a federal holiday has not been passed.
Easter Monday is observed as "Dyngus Day" in some areas.
